g.text: to Perla The ferry just now
to Perla Meet at the Duskway? just now
to Perla Trout at the Marketplace just now
it rained stars till morning. Galeazzo at the observatory writes it all down in his little book.
Your letter to Perla is on its way.
Pass us the pipeweed, would you?
Can't smoke in there, the innkeeper says. Says it stains the beams.
Your letter to Perla is on its way.
Your letter to Perla is on its way.
